integrity.claim_basis: Analytic Cauchy--Schwarz symmetrization plus exact triple-convolution polynomial and elementary symmetric bounds.
integrity.unproved_limits: No unrestricted sharp constant asserted for N<=6, other frequency sets, or other exponents.
integrity.verification_basis: Standalone standard-library checker included and executed; exact symbolic coefficients and supplementary finite tests.

scientific_limitations: Only the six specified planar root frequencies and sixth moments are treated.
Finite-grid equality is proved for square cyclic orders N>=7, not for smaller grids.
Bibliographic priority is based on documented searches and primary-material comparisons, not an exhaustive independent audit.
title: Sharp sixth Fourier moment and phase rigidity for the hexagonal root aperture
